name: Kemlon Products & Development Co Inc

hero.title: Making connectors for hostile environments since 1950
hero.lead: Kemlon Products is a Pearland, Texas machine shop and manufacturer of electrical connectors, sensors, probes and related components, with machining, molding, plating and assembly done in-house.

highlights.title: Founded in 1950
highlights.text: We are a well-established multidiscipline manufacturing company.

highlights.title: Patented glass-to-metal sealing
highlights.text: We hold several patents covering glass-to-metal and hybrid glass-to-metal/thermoplastic sealing.

highlights.title: Pioneered PEEK molding
highlights.text: We pioneered injection molding of PEEK in 1981.

highlights.title: 14 graduate engineers
highlights.text: Our engineers average over 21 years of experience at Kemlon.

credentials.label: ASNT
credentials.detail: Personnel certified for liquid penetrant testing to ACCP Level II

about.title: Founded in 1950, built for hostile environments
text: Kemlon was founded in 1950 as a multidiscipline manufacturer of electrical connectors, sensors, probes and related components for hostile environments.

We are headquartered in Pearland, Texas, and our Schulenburg location on I-10 was completed in October 2006. Larger pieces are handled by our sister company, Keystone Engineering Co., Ltd., under common ownership and management.

We design and build all our plastic and rubber molds in-house, which gives a speedy turnaround from drawing to finished part. Our work serves oil and gas, military, nuclear, aerospace, medical, marine, refrigeration and communications.
